name: benchmark-fiqa
description: Benchmark-FiQA is a collection designed to evaluate models on financial question answering and related finance-domain language understanding tasks. It includes finance-specific questions and prompts that test factual knowledge, sentiment and reasoning in the financial domain. The benchmark is intended to measure model performance on real-world finance text and decision-support style queries.
reputation: A niche dataset used primarily by researchers in financial NLP and domain-specific QA, with moderate recognition in that community.
